newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade brisk at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade brisk at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 32,100 slaughter steers and 19,200 heifers; 73,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 16,000 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 66.00-66.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00, pen North Plains 67.50. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 66.00-66.50.
Wk to Date - 73,300 Week ago - 1,700 Year ago - 44,500
